definitions.covered_fields: exists, node_name, node_value (text/comment/cdata), attributes (per name), children (ordered backendNodeIds); pseudo elements excluded on both sides
definitions.unestablished_fields: visibility, geometry, occlusion, focus, value_property, ax_role, ax_name, ax_states: always unknown in the mirror (no subscribed event establishes them)
definitions.bracketing_window: R_a = mirror revision read immediately before the normal snapshot's DOM.getDocument is sent; after that read, an ordered Page.getFrameTree round trip on the mirror's own session, then every queued event is applied (the cut). Nodes the mirror changed after R_a (or whose nearest mirrored ancestor changed after R_a) may postdate the fresh read and are counted ambiguous_in_flight, never as agreement or false-current. raw_differences_including_window is reported alongside.
definitions.false_current: a covered field the mirror holds as current (coverage current, field not uncertain, node not in an unpushed subtree, outside the bracketing window) that differs from the fresh read; action-relevant if the node is in the closure (ancestors + descendants) of a fresh semantic node with role=button name=Submit or role textbox/searchbox
definitions.unknown_share: unknown (node,field) checks / all checks on action-relevant nodes, unestablished fields included
definitions.match_set: fresh: count of role=button name=Submit (and actionable visible); mirror: status always 'unknown' (AX/visibility derived); a DOM-level look-alike estimate is logged as a diagnostic, never as a claim
definitions.event_lag: t(i107.mirror.op_applied for the op's data-i107-op stamp) - (a) server ack receipt t_mono_ns (biased low by page->server latency) and (b) the page's wall-clock mutation time mapped to CLOCK_MONOTONIC at receipt (bias = clock mapping error)
definitions.audit_void: an audit whose cut times out or whose ping fails is recorded coverage unknown (cut_unavailable / cut_ping_failed), never compared

infrastructure.status_at_freeze: the map's blocker (bwrap hostless v1 remapping root-owned Chrome to uid 65534) is superseded at the canonical hostless path by a Landlock-based hostless v2 (installed 2026-10-02T05:06Z; v1 kept as hostless-strict). Under v2 the Chrome executable shows uid 0. REAL blocks start only after the orchestrator confirms v2 as the approved isolation wrapper; until then every REAL cell is BLOCKED.
infrastructure.known_v2_gap: Landlock scope covers abstract unix sockets and signals, not pathname sockets (/tmp/.X11-unix/X*, /run/user/<uid>/*); those paths rely on the environment scrub. The runner refuses to start unless inside hostless (no_new_privs or a non-identity uid map) and inside the private X11 session.

deviations_disclosed: Protocol events confirmed from the installed Chrome's resources.pak (the resource behind /json/protocol), not from the Driver-launched endpoint inside the session; the endpoint read is repeated if REAL runs.
DOM.adRelatedStateUpdated and DOM.distributedNodesUpdated (present in Chrome 151) fall into the mirror's conservative unmodeled -> invalidate path; neither establishes a covered field.
